summary: First-run full-stack test of MotoCom. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS covering auth (register/login/me + duplicate/401), groups (create/list/get/members/join/invalid-code/leave), messages (send + asc order), locations (upsert), devices (add auto-disconnect others, toggle, delete), rides (create + reverse-chrono), and _id leak check across all resources. Frontend: verified login screen loads unauthenticated, register-> dashboard, Log Ride adds to Recent Rides, Pair Intercom scan+PAIR saves & marks device Connected, Groups create + open detail with CHAT tab (message appears) and MEMBERS tab (invite code visible), Live Map shows group chip + Broadcast increments active riders count and renders a rider marker, PTT hold changes label to TRANSMITTING (verified via touch events; ptt-channel-name reflects selected group), Profile screen accessible from dashboard header, Sign out returns to login, wrong-password login displays login-error. Google button present and not clicked as instructed. No critical bugs. Two Expo/RN deprecation console warnings observed (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted by react-native-web. Consider migrating shadow props to boxShadow for web parity. Reference: styles across screens (grep for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in /app/frontend/app/**).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Some component passes pointerEvents as prop instead of style. Reference: search pointerEvents= in /app/frontend/app/** and /app/frontend/src/**.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to remove RN web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Move pointerEvents from prop to style.pointerEvents to remove RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses EmailStr strict validation which rejects .test TLD (reserved). Tests updated to use motocom-test.com; keep in mind for future seed data.

GET /api/groups/{id} and /messages/locations do not enforce membership check - any authenticated user can read any group's data if they know the group_id. Consider adding membership check for privacy.
POST /api/groups/{id}/messages and /location do not verify caller is a group member either. Minor privacy concern but not a functional bug for the current scope.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users with emails like test_a_<hex>@motocom-test.com and test_b_<hex>@motocom-test.com plus TEST_Group_<hex>. No cleanup needed for this preview DB (unique per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://intercom-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Create users via POST /api/auth/register with a non-.test TLD (EmailStr rejects .test). Use Authorization: Bearer <token> header. All endpoints strip _id in responses. Frontend testIDs are documented inline; PTT button on web preview responds to touch events (dispatchEvent 'touchstart'/'touchend') rather than mouse.down/mouse.up - use touch events when scripting PTT hold. Tab labels are Ride/Map/Talk/Groups; access via page.get_by_role('tab', name='Ride') to disambiguate from other 'Map/Talk' text on screen. Google OAuth button (google-signin-button) exists on login and MUST NOT be clicked in automated tests.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA. Note: initial pytest run failed with 422 due to EmailStr rejecting .test TLD - fixed test data to @motocom-test.com. Initial PTT UI test appeared to fail (state stayed HOLD TO TALK) using page.mouse.down/up; root cause is that RN-Web's Pressable listens to touch/pointer events for onPressIn/Out - re-tested with dispatched touch events and PTT correctly transitions to TRANSMITTING then back to HOLD TO TALK. Functionality is correct on real devices.
